limitations: The provider field isinGrowth stores payout ISINs for these IDCW options; its field name does not establish Growth eligibility.
The documented 19 June effective date, CDSL 18 June identifier activation date, and saved 19/20 June NAV boundary are distinct facts. No primary close-of-business timing claim is made for this event.
The original review used checkpoint 255. The final production replay uses checkpoint 256; no original archive hash has been relabeled.
All 53,773 retained points are reviewed. This does not assert that every historical source observation is present.
Unit normalization establishes a consistent unit denomination for a calculation copy. It does not establish distribution-adjusted total returns or consumer ranking eligibility.
Raw observations and raw archive warnings/flags remain unchanged; the replay file records calculation-copy outcomes.
The four excluded identities remain unregistered.
